column40: Rounded is the new generation of treasury management app dealing with both fiat- and crypto-currencies
column41: We are creating a subscription-based cash management web app that allows organizations to manage fiat and crypto flows from a single interface.  We noticed that it is extremely painful for companies with crypto and fiat streams to manage their treasury as a whole. They juggle multiple interfaces and multiple data standards across platforms preventing them from running detailed analytics on their financials. Rounded solves this problem by: - Tracking all users’ executed transactions on crypto wallets, centralized exchange accounts, and bank accounts. We rely on third-party providers to collect banking data. - Recording transactions in a compliant format. Every crypto transaction is matched with the appropriate crypto-fiat rate conversion. Thanks to data format uniformity, accounting is simplified. - Providing a snapshot of the company’s global cash situation. - Delivering an interface to build custom analytics from users’ cash flows. Insights are powered by a semi-automatic categorization tool relying on historical users’ inputs.
